name: Onigiri

descriptions.normal: A portable dish made with rice. It is simple to make and remains delicious at room temperatures, which has made it very popular with civilians and soldiers alike.
descriptions.suspicious: A portable dish made with rice. It just about has a triangle shape, but is so loose that it threatens to disintegrate should you pick it up. Yes, disintegrate- like the expectations of your prospective guests.
descriptions.delicious: A portable dish made with rice. The crispy seaweed adds a bit of umami to the down-to-earth sweetness of the glutinous rice. For the final touch, the fresh fish within the Onigiri strikes like an ambushing band, and the satisfaction it brings to body and mind is like the clarion flourish of victory.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 20% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 390 HP every 5s for 30s.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 18% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300 HP every 5s for 30s.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 22% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 470 HP every 5s for 30s.
